_meta.purpose: Locked parameter database for the GRAMMAR-HIERARCHY interpreter. The DNA blueprint is read at MORE THAN ONE grammatical level. The cell-level reads (the material gamma, the A4 coordinate) read the LOWEST level: the physical/chemical material of adjacent base pairs (nearest-neighbour stacking free energy -- electrostatics and base-stacking, i.e. 'ions/chemistry'). That is the bottom blueprint. This package formalizes the HIGHER blueprints the cell-level reading misses: a TISSUE-level grammar (the cis-regulatory syntax -- the arrangement of transcription-factor binding sites, here the cardiac TF code) and an ORGAN-level grammar (the architecture/arrangement map -- colinearity and element layout). Each level gets the SAME (LEVEL, SHAPE) = (gamma, A4) decomposition via the identical robust_z operator. The discovery: the tissue arrangement that Appendix A/D could not get from the cell-level material gamma -- and had to import as external measured moduli -- is WRITTEN in the sequence at a higher grammatical level we had not read.

the_linguistic_hierarchy.G1_material_cell: PHONOLOGY -- the physical substance of the letters. Signal = nearest-neighbour stacking dG (SantaLucia 1998). gamma_1 = mean (the material level), A4_1 = robust_z (the material pattern). This is what the corpus has read.
the_linguistic_hierarchy.G2_regulatory_tissue: SYNTAX -- how control words are arranged. Signal = local density/arrangement of the CARDIAC TF binding grammar (GATA, NKE/NKX2-5, MEF2, T-box/TBX5, E-box/HAND). gamma_2 = mean regulatory drive, A4_2 = robust_z arrangement (the tissue-identity / arrangement pattern). THE MISSED UPPER A4.
the_linguistic_hierarchy.G3_architecture_organ: DISCOURSE -- how the whole text is laid out. Signal = the inter-element spacing/arrangement of the G2 regulatory hotspots (the layout). gamma_3 = mean layout regularity, A4_3 = robust_z arrangement map (the 배치도).

_meta.rule: MEASURED-AND-CITED (real genomic sequences, published NN parameters, published TF consensus motifs) or EXACT (the robust_z decomposition, the dinucleotide-shuffle invariance). No parameter is tuned to a target. The cardiac-vs-noncardiac contrast uses REAL human promoters, so it is not circular.

grades.[L]: locked: measured/published value, real genomic sequence, or cited motif
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (consensus motif set, window size); declared
grades.[O]: open: real-tissue-arrangement validation absent; named obstacle

nn_stacking_dG_kcal_per_mol._axis: G1 MATERIAL -- SantaLucia 1998 unified nearest-neighbour Delta-G(37C) parameters (kcal/mol), the cell-level material the corpus already uses. The signal s1[i] = dG(S[i:i+2]) along the sequence; gamma_1 = mean(s1), A4_1 = robust_z(s1).
nn_stacking_dG_kcal_per_mol.provenance: SantaLucia J Jr 1998, PNAS 95:1460-1465, 'A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics'. Unified NN Delta-G_37 set; the same pipeline the corpus uses for measured gamma.

cardiac_tf_grammar._axis: G2 REGULATORY -- the CARDIAC transcription-factor binding grammar. These five factors form the core cardiac regulatory network; their combinatorial binding-site syntax specifies cardiac tissue identity and arrangement. The signal s2[i] = number of cardiac-TF consensus matches (either strand) in a window centred at i.
cardiac_tf_grammar.provenance: Core cardiac TF code: GATA4, NKX2-5, MEF2C, TBX5, and bHLH/HAND. Consensus motifs from JASPAR (GATA4 MA0482; NKX2-5 MA0063; MEF2C MA0497; TBX5 MA0807; bHLH E-box) and the cardiac-GRN literature (Olson 2006, Science 313:1922; Bruneau 2013, CSH Perspect Biol 5:a008292; Akazawa & Komuro 2003). The combinatorial arrangement of these sites is the established cis-regulatory grammar of cardiac enhancers.

window_bp.note: sliding-window half-width for the regulatory density signal; a documented choice, not tuned to a target

real_sequences._axis: REAL human genomic promoter sequences (GRCh38), fetched from NCBI, embedded for deterministic offline reproduction. Two CARDIAC promoters (rich cardiac TF grammar) and one HOUSEKEEPING promoter (the non-cardiac control). The contrast is not circular: these are unmodified genomic sequences.

NPPA_cardiac.provenance: Human NPPA proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000001.11 11847783-11848682 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand). NPPA is a canonical cardiac-restricted gene whose promoter carries GATA and NKE (NKX2-5) cardiac elements.

TNNT2_cardiac.provenance: Human TNNT2 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000001.11 201377680-201378579 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS). TNNT2 is a cardiac-muscle-restricted gene with characterized cardiac regulatory elements.

GAPDH_housekeeping.provenance: Human GAPDH proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000012.12 6533617-6534516 (plus) (900 bp upstream of TSS). GAPDH is a ubiquitously-expressed housekeeping gene with a CpG-island promoter and NO cardiac-specific regulatory program -- the negative control for the cardiac grammar.

shuffle._axis: The dinucleotide-preserving shuffle (Altschul-Erickson Eulerian-path). It preserves dinucleotide counts EXACTLY, hence preserves the G1 material grammar (the stacking-dG distribution, gamma_1 and the A4_1 statistics), while randomizing the POSITIONS of all higher-order structure (motifs). Used to PROVE the regulatory grammar G2 is information ABOVE the material level G1.
shuffle.provenance: Altschul SF & Erickson BW 1985, Mol Biol Evol 2:526-538, 'Significance of nucleotide sequence alignments: a method for random sequence permutation that preserves dinucleotide and codon usage'.

seed.note: fixed deterministic seed (the DOI number) so the shuffle is reproducible under 2x SHA-256

appendix_d_link._axis: The external-data reliance this package reduces. Appendix D had to import MEASURED cardiac moduli because the arrangement was not in the cell-level material gamma. Here the tissue arrangement is shown to be READABLE from sequence at the regulatory grammar level -- the blueprint had it.

appendix_d_needed_external_moduli.provenance: Appendix D (heart composite-renormalization) bracketed the myocardium using measured single-cell and decellularized-ECM moduli; the developmental arrangement/timing was orthogonal to the sequence material gamma (Appendix A null, rho=+0.071). This package locates that arrangement in the regulatory grammar.

_open.real_enhancer_activity: [O] validating that A4_2 (the regulatory arrangement) predicts MEASURED cardiac enhancer ACTIVITY needs a held-out functional dataset (VISTA cardiac enhancers, cardiac ATAC-seq/H3K27ac, or MPRA) with a pre-registered rank test and a shuffle control.
_open.real_arrangement_map: [O] validating that A4_3 (the architecture grammar) predicts the real spatial TISSUE arrangement (the 배치도) needs measured 3D-genome contacts (Hi-C/Micro-C) or the colinear spatial-domain TF map (Hox-style), staged.
_open.pwm_vs_consensus: [O] the consensus (IUPAC) motif matching is a documented simplification of full position-weight-matrix scoring; richer PWM scoring would raise the regulatory signal's resolution.
